questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is the diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 129°. Then, ∠BAC is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/770f8a89e831d21936ac72dbd84459b80d951037f5a1fe54d4b9deedc70e7c47.png] 

Given ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral, and ∠ADC = 129°

As we know, the sum of the either pair of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°.

⇒ ∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° – 129° = 51°

In ΔACB, if AB is diameter, then ∠ACB = 90°

⇒ ∠ACB + ∠ABC + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ 90° + 51° + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° – 90° – 51° = 39°

questions.question: A starts walking at 4 kmph and after 4 hours, B starts cycling from the same point as that of A, in the same direction at 10 kmph. After how much distance from the starting point will B catch up with A (Correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
Speed of A = 4 km/h

Distance covered by A in 4 hours = 4 × 4 = 16 km

Speed of B = 10 km/h

Time taken by B to catch up with A = 16/(10 – 4) = 16/6 = 8/3 hr

Total distance covered by B in 8/3 hrs = 10 × 8/3 = 80/3 = 26.67 km

questions.question: If a sum amounts to Rs. 2,190 in four years and Rs. 2,409 in five years at compound interest, when the interest is compounded yearly, then the annual rate of interest is:
questions.solution:
As we know, simple interest and compound interest of the first year are same.

Let the principal be Rs. 2,190 it will be in the next year Rs, 2,409

Principal = 2190 and time = 1 year and r = ?

Interest = 2409 – 2190 = 219

⇒ S.I = (P × r × t)/100

⇒ 219 = (2190 × r × 1)/100

⇒ r = 21900/2190 = 10%

questions.question: A earns Rs. 180 per hour and works for 7 hours per day. B earns Rs. 160 per hour and works for 5 hours per day. What is the ratio of the wages of A and B?
questions.solution:
A earns Rs. 180 per hour

Total earning of A if he works for 7 hours per day = 180 × 7 = 1260

B earns Rs. 160 per hour

Total earning of B if he works for 5 hours per day = 160 × 5 = 800

Ratio of the wages of A and B = 1260 : 800 = 63 : 40

questions.question: What is the difference between a single discount of 30% and a single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 25% and 5%, being given on shopping of Rs. 2,000?
questions.solution:
**Short trick: **

Single Successive equivalent discount of 25% and 5%

⇒ 25 + 5 – [(25 × 5)/100] = (30 – 1.25)%

Required difference between a single discount of 30% and single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 25% and 5% = 30% – (30 – 1.25)% = 30 – 30 + 1.25 = 1.25%

Required difference = Rs. 2000 × 1.25/100 = Rs. 25

**Detailed solution: **

Shopping price after discount = Rs. 2000 × 70/100 = 1400

Shopping price after two successive discounts of 25% and 5% = Rs. 2000 × 75/100 × 95/100 = 1425

Required difference = 1425 – 1400 = Rs. 25

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 50°. Its sides AB and AC are produced to the point D and E. If the bisectors of the ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at the point O, then ∠BOC will be equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6bd6d5cd7783b63dacb447b32a38da72a7bb311b878ef543114406c14c3ead9.png] 

The angle between the external bisectors of two angles of a triangle is difference between right angle and half of the third angle.

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – [∠A/2]

Given, ∠A = 50°

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – 50/2

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – 25° = 65°

questions.question: 3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 6 days. A woman does triple the work a man does and a boy does half the work a man does. How many women alone will be able to complete this work in 4 days?
questions.solution:
3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 6 days

According to the question

⇒ W = 3M

⇒ M : W = 1 : 3

⇒ B = M/2

⇒ M : B = 2 : 1

Efficiency of man, woman and boy (M : W : B) = 2 : 6 : 1

Total work = (3M + 4W + 6B) × 6

⇒ (3 × 2 + 4 × 6 + 6 × 1) × 6 = 216

Suppose x women alone can complete that work in 4 days, then

⇒ x × 6 × 4 = 216

⇒ x = 9 days

questions.question: PA and PB are tangents to a circle with centre O, from a point P outside the circle, and A and B are points on the circle. If ∠APB = 40°, then ∠OAB is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given, ∠APB = 40°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f92f886104df0561bebcab0e2b7efa5e3f807a045e4b87883a9e0810df4c25ad.png] 

As we know,

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠APB = 180°

⇒ ∠AOB = 180° – 40° = 140°

In ΔOAB

OA = OB radius of the circle

∴ ∠OAB = ∠OBA

⇒ ∠OAB + ∠OBA + ∠AOB = 180°

⇒ 2∠OAB = 180 – ∠AOB = 180° – 140° = 40°

⇒ ∠OAB = 20°

questions.question: The average of 27 numbers is zero. Out of them, how many may be greater than zero, at the most?
questions.solution:
Let there are 26 numbers value of each number is 1 then we can say sum of all 26 numbers is 26 and another 27th number whose value is (-26), then

⇒ Average of all 27 numbers = (26 – 26)/27 = 0

Now, we can say there are 26 numbers may be greater than zero.

questions.question: If the radius of the circumcircle of an equilateral triangle is 8 cm, then the measure of radius of its incircle is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

Radius of circum-circle is 2 times of the radius of in-circle of an equilateral triangle.

Radius of in-circle = 8/2 = 4 cm

questions.question: When an integer n is divided by 8, the remainder is 3. What will be the remainder if 6n – 1 is divided by 8?
questions.solution:
When an integer n is divided by 8, then remainder is 3

Let the value of n be 11 which satisfied the condition.

According to the question

⇒ (6n – 1) ÷ 8

⇒ (6 × 11 – 1) ÷ 8

⇒ (66 – 1) ÷ 8

⇒ 65 ÷ 8

Remainder will be 1

questions.question: A sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into spheres of radius 2 cm each. How many such spheres can be made?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Volume of sphere = 4/3 π r³

Radius of bigger sphere R = 6 cm

and radius of smaller sphere = 2 cm

Suppose x small spheres made by the bigger sphere.

According to the question

⇒ 4/3 π r³ × x = 4/3 π R³

⇒ 4/3 × π × 2³ × x = 4/3 × π × 6³

⇒ x = 27

questions.question: If the selling price of 40 articles is equal to the cost price of 50 articles, then the percentage loss or gain is:
questions.solution:
Given, selling price of 40 articles is equal to the cost price of 50 articles

According to the question

40 SP = 50 CP

SP/CP = 50/40

SP : CP = 5 : 4

Suppose SP = 5 unit and CP = 4 unit

Profit = SP – CP = 5 – 4 = 1

Profit percentage = 1/4 × 100 = 25%

questions.question: If 3 cos² A + 7 sin² A = 4, then what is the value of cot A, given that A is an acute angle?
questions.solution:
As we know, sin²A + cos²A = 1

⇒ 3 cos² A + 7 sin² A = 4

⇒ 3 cos²A + 3 sin² A + 4 sin²A = 4

⇒ 3(cos²A + sin² A) + 4 sin²A = 4

⇒ 3 × 1 + 4 sin² A = 4

⇒ 4 sin²A = 4 – 3 = 1

⇒ sin²A = 1/4

⇒ sin A = 1/2

⇒ sin A = sin 30°

⇒ A = 30°

⇒ cot A = cot 30° = √3

questions.question: If a³ – b³ = 208 and a – b = 4, then (a + b)² – ab is equal to:
questions.solution:
⇒ a³– b³ = (a – b) [(a + b)² – ab]

Given, a³ – b³ = 208 and a – b = 4

⇒ 208 = 4 [(a + b)² – ab]

⇒ [(a + b)² – ab] = 208/4 = 52
